import MilneLib.Sheaf.InvariantModuleBaseChange
import MilneLib.Sheaf.TildePullback

/-!
# Base change of associated invariant sheaves

An equivariant restriction map which realizes ordinary module base change
also realizes pullback of the associated invariant sheaves across the two
fixed rings. On an open immersion this gives the native restriction
comparison needed for stable affine overlaps in Milne III.1.13. The ordinary
base-change hypothesis must still be supplied from the original sheaf.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

variable (K L R T : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
  [Algebra K R] [Algebra L R] [IsScalarTower K L R]
  [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R] [IsSemilinear K L R]
  [Algebra K T] [Algebra L T] [IsScalarTower K L T]
  [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) T] [IsSemilinear K L T]
  [Algebra R T]
  [Algebra (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L))]
  [IsScalarTower (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) T]
  (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [Module L M]
  [Module R M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) M]
  [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M]
  (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [Module L N]
  [Module R N] [Module T N] [IsScalarTower K L N]
  [IsScalarTower L T N] [IsScalarTower K T N] [IsScalarTower R T N]
  [IsScalarTower (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) N]
  [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) N] [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) T N]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

local notation "A" => FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
local notation "B" => FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)

/-- Ordinary equivariant module base change induces pullback of the
associated sheaves of invariants over the fixed rings. -/
noncomputable def invariantModuleTildeBaseChangeIso (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (h : Function.Bijective (moduleBaseChangeMap R T M N f)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))).obj
        (tilde (R := CommRingCat.of A) (ModuleCat.of A (invariantModule K L R M))) ≅
      tilde (R := CommRingCat.of B) (ModuleCat.of B (invariantModule K L T N)) := by
  let e := (invariantModuleBaseChangeEquiv K L R T M N f hf h).toModuleIso
  exact MilneLib.pullbackSpecTildeTensorIso (R := CommRingCat.of A) (S := CommRingCat.of B)
      (ModuleCat.of A (invariantModule K L R M)) ≪≫
    (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of B)).mapIso e

/-- On an affine open, ordinary equivariant module base change induces
the actual restriction of associated invariant sheaves. -/
noncomputable def invariantModuleTildeBaseChangeRestrictionIso
    [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (h : Function.Bijective (moduleBaseChangeMap R T M N f)) :
    (tilde (R := CommRingCat.of A) (ModuleCat.of A (invariantModule K L R M))).restrict
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) ≅
      tilde (R := CommRingCat.of B) (ModuleCat.of B (invariantModule K L T N)) :=
  (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))).app _ ≪≫
    invariantModuleTildeBaseChangeIso K L R T M N f hf h

end MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
